blocks.text: Yeh chapter 32 (Medicine, Agriculture and Industry) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Which two aspects of a drug are described as very crucial aspects of medicine?
(Kisi drug ke kaun se do pehlu medicine ke liye bohat aham bataye gaye hain?)

options.text: us ki safety limits aur behtareen dose range
us ka melting point aur density

blocks.explanation: Drug ki safety limits (hifazati hudood) aur behtareen dose range medicine ke do bohat aham pehlu hain.

book_ref.quote: safety limits and optimal dose range are two very crucial aspects of medicine

blocks.prompt:
2 Pharmacology is the science which deals with:
(Pharmacology woh science hai jo kis cheez se mutaliq hai?)

options.text: drug kya karta hai aur kin safety margins mein kaam karta hai

blocks.explanation: Pharmacology yeh batati hai ke drug kya karta hai aur kin safety margins (hifazati hudood) ke andar kaam karta hai (32.1).

book_ref.quote: Pharmacology is the science which deals with, what a drug does

blocks.prompt:
3 According to the chapter, what decides whether a drug acts as a medicine or a poison?
(Chapter ke mutabiq kya cheez tay karti hai ke drug dawa banega ya zehar?)
blocks.explanation: Har drug mumkina zehar ho sakta hai; farq sirf dose (miqdaar) ka hai (32.1).

book_ref.quote: Every drug may be a potential poison; the difference lies in the dose of each drug.

blocks.prompt:
4 The therapeutic window is:
(Therapeutic window kya hai?)

options.text: plasma mein drug concentration ki woh range jo bina nuqsan ke asar kare
woh kam se kam dose jo zehar shuru kare
woh dose jo 50% logon par asar kare
toxic dose aur effective dose ka ratio

blocks.explanation: Therapeutic window plasma mein drug ki woh concentration range hai jo asar karti hai magar nuqsan-deh side effects nahi deti (32.1.1).

book_ref.quote: is the range of drug concentrations in the plasma that are effective without causing harmful side effects

blocks.prompt:
5 The therapeutic window is called the 'sweet spot' of medicine because the drug concentration in it is:
(Therapeutic window ko medicine ka 'sweet spot' kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: na itni kam ke be-asar ho, na itni ziyada ke khatarnak ho
har mareez ke liye aik jaisi

blocks.explanation: Is mein concentration na itni kam ke asar na kare, na itni ziyada ke khatarnak ho (32.1.1).

book_ref.quote: of medicine i.e. not too less to be ineffective and also not too high to be dangerous

blocks.prompt:
6 Minimum effective concentration (MEC) is the:
(Minimum effective concentration (MEC) kya hai?)

options.text: woh kam se kam dose jis se neeche drug asar nahi karta
woh kam se kam dose jis par nuqsan shuru ho
woh dose jo 50% logon ke liye zehreeli ho
drug ke window mein rehne ka waqt

blocks.explanation: MEC woh kam se kam dose hai jis se neeche drug ka clinical (ilaaji) asar nahi hota (32.1.1).

book_ref.quote: is the lowest dose of the drug below which it fails to produce a clinical effect

blocks.prompt:
7 The lowest dose at which a drug begins to cause adverse effects or poisoning is called:
(Woh kam se kam dose jis par drug nuqsan ya zehar ka asar shuru kare, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: MTC woh kam se kam dose hai jis par drug adverse effects (nuqsan-deh asraat) shuru karta hai (32.1.1).

book_ref.quote: is the lowest dose at which drug begins to cause adverse effects

blocks.prompt:
8 The time for which the drug concentration remains within its therapeutic window is the:
(Jitna waqt drug ki concentration therapeutic window ke andar rehti hai, use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Duration of action woh waqt hai jis mein drug concentration therapeutic window mein rehti hai (32.1.1).

book_ref.quote: is the time duration in which the drug concentration remains within its therapeutic window

blocks.prompt:
9 A drug with a wide therapeutic window:
(Wide (chaurri) therapeutic window wale drug ke baare mein kya sahi hai?)

options.text: effective dose toxic dose ke bohat qareeb hai
mareez ko kabhi nahi diya ja sakta
asar karne wali aur nuqsan-deh dose mein bara faasla hai

blocks.explanation: Wide window ka matlab hai asar karne wali aur nuqsan-deh dose mein bara faasla, is liye dose mein ziyada gunjaish (32.1.1).

book_ref.quote: A wide therapeutic window indicates the safety limits of a drug

blocks.prompt:
10 For a drug with a narrow therapeutic window, doctors often:
(Narrow (tang) therapeutic window wale drug ke liye doctors aksar kya karte hain?)

options.text: mareez ka blood check karte hain ta ke level tang range mein rahe
hifazat ke liye dose double karte hain
baqi sab checks band kar dete hain

blocks.explanation: Narrow window wala drug kam mehfooz hai; doctor mareez ka blood check karte hain ta ke level sahi range mein rahe (32.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Doctors must be extremely careful when prescribing these drugs

blocks.prompt:
11 Which of the following is NOT given as a factor affecting the therapeutic window of a drug?
(In mein se kaun sa factor therapeutic window par asar daalne wala NAHI bataya gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Kai dawaiyan aik saath, genetic factors, motapa, umar aur sehat window par asar daalte hain; tablet ka rang nahi (32.1.1).

book_ref.quote: genetic factors, obesity, age, or overall health may also affect the therapeutic window

blocks.prompt:
12 A drug has MEC = 4 mg dm⁻³ and MTC = 20 mg dm⁻³. A plasma concentration of 25 mg dm⁻³ is:
(Aik drug ka MEC = 4 mg dm⁻³ aur MTC = 20 mg dm⁻³ hai. Plasma concentration 25 mg dm⁻³ kis hissay mein hai?)

options.text: MTC se oopar, is liye nuqsan de sakti hai
MEC se neeche, is liye be-asar

blocks.explanation: Window 4 se 20 mg dm⁻³ hai; 25 is MTC se oopar hai jahan nuqsan shuru hota hai (32.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Minimum effective concentration (MEC) is the lowest dose of the drug

blocks.prompt:
13 For the same drug (MEC = 4 mg dm⁻³, MTC = 20 mg dm⁻³), a plasma concentration of 2 mg dm⁻³ is:
(Usi drug (MEC = 4, MTC = 20 mg dm⁻³) ke liye 2 mg dm⁻³ concentration kaisi hai?)

options.text: MTC se oopar, is liye zehreeli
MEC se neeche, is liye asar nahi karegi

blocks.explanation: 2 mg dm⁻³ MEC (4) se kam hai, is liye drug ka asar nahi hoga (32.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Minimum toxic concentration (MTC) is the lowest dose at which drug

blocks.prompt:
14 The therapeutic index (TI) is a quantitative measurement of a drug's:
(Therapeutic index (TI) drug ki kis cheez ki miqdaari (quantitative) pemaish hai?)
blocks.explanation: TI drug ki safety (hifazat) ki miqdaari pemaish hai (32.1.2).

book_ref.quote: The therapeutic index (TI) is a quantitative measurement of a drug

blocks.prompt:
15 The therapeutic index of a drug is given by:
(Drug ka therapeutic index kis formula se milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: TI toxic dose ko effective dose se compare karta hai: TI = TD₅₀/ED₅₀ (figure mein ulta chhapa hai, woh ghalat hai) (32.1.2).

book_ref.quote: the therapeutic index is TD50/ED50

blocks.prompt:
16 TD₅₀ (toxic dose 50) is the dose that:
(TD₅₀ (toxic dose 50) kya hai?)

options.text: lene walon mein se 50% par zehreela asar kare
lene walon mein se 50% par kaam kare

blocks.explanation: TD₅₀ woh dose hai jo lene walon mein se 50% par zehreela asar kare (32.1.2).

book_ref.quote: is the dose that causes a toxic effect in 50% of the people who take it

blocks.prompt:
17 ED₅₀ (effective dose 50) is defined as the dose that:
(ED₅₀ (effective dose 50) kya hai?)

options.text: lene walon mein se 50% par kaam kare
drug ko 50 ghante window mein rakhe

blocks.explanation: ED₅₀ woh dose hai jo lene walon mein se 50% par kaam kare (32.1.2).

book_ref.quote: is defined as the dose that works for 50% of the people who take it

blocks.prompt:
18 A higher therapeutic index means that the drug is:
(Ziyada therapeutic index ka matlab hai ke drug:)

options.text: ziyada mehfooz, effective aur toxic dose mein bara farq
kisi dose par asar nahi karta

blocks.explanation: Ziyada TI ka matlab drug ziyada mehfooz hai, kyun ke effective aur toxic dose mein bara farq hai (32.1.2).

book_ref.quote: A higher TI means the drug is safer

blocks.prompt:
19 Four drugs have TI values of 1.5, 3, 6 and 12. The safest drug has a TI of:
(Chaar drugs ke TI 1.5, 3, 6 aur 12 hain. Sab se mehfooz drug ka TI kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jitna ziyada TI, utna mehfooz drug; is liye 12 sab se mehfooz hai (32.1.2).

book_ref.quote: For example, a drug with a TI of 10 is much safer than one with a TI of 2.

blocks.prompt:
20 A drug has ED₅₀ = 15 mg and TD₅₀ = 450 mg. Its therapeutic index is:
(Aik drug ka ED₅₀ = 15 mg aur TD₅₀ = 450 mg hai. Is ka therapeutic index kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: It compares the dose that causes a toxic effect to the dose that produces a desired therapeutic effect.

blocks.prompt:
21 A drug has TD₅₀ = 60 mg and a therapeutic index of 4. Its ED₅₀ is:
(Aik drug ka TD₅₀ = 60 mg aur TI = 4 hai. Is ka ED₅₀ kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: A low TI means the drug is more dangerous and requires careful monitoring

blocks.prompt:
22 A drug has ED₅₀ = 25 mg and a therapeutic index of 8. Its TD₅₀ is:
(Aik drug ka ED₅₀ = 25 mg aur TI = 8 hai. Is ka TD₅₀ kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: A higher TI means the drug is safer because there's a larger difference

blocks.prompt:
23 Which pair of drugs has a high therapeutic index?
(Kis jore ke drugs ka therapeutic index ziyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin aur paracetamol ka TI ziyada hai; warfarin aur digoxin ka kam (32.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Drugs like Penicillin or Paracetamol have high TI.

blocks.prompt:
24 Warfarin, which must be taken only in proper dosage, is a:
(Warfarin, jo sirf sahi dose mein lena zaroori hai, kya hai?)

options.text: blood thinner (khoon patla karne wali dawa)
poppy se bani dard ki dawa

blocks.explanation: Warfarin blood thinner (khoon patla karne wali dawa) hai; is ka TI kam hai (32.1.2).

book_ref.quote: drugs like Warfarin (a blood thinner) or Digoxin (heart medicine)

blocks.prompt:
25 Patients using low TI drugs need regular blood tests for:
(Kam TI wale drugs lene wale mareezon ke regular blood tests kis liye hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kam TI drugs ke liye regular blood tests therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) ke liye hote hain (32.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Patients using low TI drugs must carry regular blood tests for therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM).

blocks.prompt:
26 Before modern blood-level monitoring, digoxin was a frequent cause of accidental hospital deaths because:
(Modern blood monitoring se pehle digoxin hospital mein hadsati amwaat ki wajah kyun banta tha?)

options.text: TI itna kam ke chhote asar bhi mareez ko toxic zone mein le jate
is ka TI bohat ziyada hai
hospital mein kabhi istemal nahi hua
is ke koi side effects nahi

blocks.explanation: Digoxin ka TI itna kam hai ke khane ya dawaon ke chhote asar bhi mareez ko zehreele hissay mein le jate (32.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Digoxin was a frequent cause of accidental hospital deaths

blocks.prompt:
27 Digoxin toxicity causes:
(Digoxin ki zehreeli miqdaar kya asar karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Digoxin toxicity ventricular fibrillation (dil ki jaan-lewa dharkan) aur peeli nazar (xanthopsia) paida karti hai (32.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Its toxicity causes ventricular fibrillation (a fatal heart rhythm)

blocks.prompt:
28 The pH of the stomach lies in the range:
(Maiday (stomach) ki pH kis range mein hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Maiday mein bohat tezabi mahol hai, pH 1.5–3.5 (32.2).

book_ref.quote: The stomach has a highly acidic environment with a low pH

blocks.prompt:
29 The acidity of the stomach is regulated by:
(Maiday ki tezabiyat ko kaun control karta hai?)

options.text: red blood cells jo OH⁻ ions chhorte hain
parietal cells jo H⁺ ions maiday mein pump karte hain

blocks.explanation: Parietal cells H⁺ ions ko maiday mein pump karte hain (32.2).

book_ref.quote: This acidity is regulated by parietal cells

blocks.prompt:
30 The acidic environment of the stomach is important for:
(Maiday ka tezabi mahol kis liye zaroori hai?)

options.text: khana hazam karna aur bacteria maarna

blocks.explanation: Yeh khana hazam karne aur bacteria marne ke liye zaroori hai (32.2).

book_ref.quote: This process is important for digesting food and killing bacteria.

blocks.prompt:
31 The stomach protects itself from its own acid by:
(Maida apne hi tezaab se apne aap ko kaise bachata hai?)

options.text: mucus aur bicarbonate ions ki moti teh

blocks.explanation: Maida mucus (balgham jaisi teh) aur bicarbonate ions ki moti teh se bachta hai jo cell ki satah par tezaab ko neutral karte hain (32.2).

book_ref.quote: it protects itself via a thick layer of mucus and bicarbonate ions

blocks.prompt:
32 The low pH of the stomach can cause non-specific reactions, which means it can:
(Maiday ki kam pH non-specific reactions kar sakti hai; is ka matlab hai ke:)

options.text: kuch drugs ko kimiyaai taur par badal de
har drug ka TI barha de

blocks.explanation: Matlab tezaab kuch drugs ko kimiyaai taur par badal sakta hai; kuch jazb hone se pehle toot jate hain (32.2).

book_ref.quote: The low pH of stomach can cause non-specific reactions

blocks.prompt:
33 Some medicines are given in a protective coating that dissolves only in the:
(Kuch dawaon par hifazati coating hoti hai jo sirf kahan hal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch drugs tezaab mein toot jate hain, is liye coating sirf kam tezabi small intestine mein hal hoti hai (32.2).

book_ref.quote: This is why some medications are given in a protective coating

blocks.prompt:
34 The mechanism of action of a drug is:
(Drug ka mechanism of action kya hai?)

options.text: cell ki satah par kaise kaam kar ke asar deta hai

blocks.explanation: Mechanism of action yeh hai ke drug cell ki satah par kaise kaam kar ke ilaaji asar deta hai (32.3).

book_ref.quote: The mechanism of action is how a drug works at a cellular level

blocks.prompt:
35 Aspirin acts by blocking the enzyme:
(Aspirin kis enzyme ko rok kar kaam karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aspirin COX enzyme ko rokti hai; yeh Chemistry XI mein parha gaya (32.3).

book_ref.quote: blocking COX enzyme has already been discussed in Chemistry XI

blocks.prompt:
36 Penicillin is used to treat:
(Penicillin kis ke ilaaj ke liye hai?)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin aik taqatwar antibiotic hai jo bohat se bacterial infections ka ilaaj karti hai (32.3.1).

book_ref.quote: It is a powerful antibiotic used to treat many types of bacterial infections

blocks.prompt:
37 Cellulitis and erysipelas, which penicillin helps to treat, are:
(Cellulitis aur erysipelas, jin ka ilaaj penicillin karti hai, kya hain?)

options.text: jild aur naram tissue ke infections

blocks.explanation: Cellulitis aur erysipelas jild (skin) aur naram tissue ke infections hain (32.3.1).

book_ref.quote: It also helps to treat skin and soft tissue infections like cellulitis, erysipelas.

blocks.prompt:
38 The two core rings in the structure of penicillin are:
(Penicillin ki structure mein do bunyaadi rings kaun si hain?)

options.text: a beta-lactam ring and a thiazolidine ring
a beta-lactam ring and a benzene ring
a thiazolidine ring and a cyclohexane ring

blocks.explanation: Penicillin mein chaar-rukni beta-lactam ring aur paanch-rukni thiazolidine ring hai (32.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The structure of Penicillin contains two core rings

blocks.prompt:
39 The number of atoms in the beta-lactam ring of penicillin is:
(Penicillin ki beta-lactam ring mein kitne atoms hain?)
blocks.explanation: Beta-lactam ring chaar-rukni hai; thiazolidine paanch-rukni (32.3.1).

book_ref.quote: a four-membered beta-lactam ring and a five membered thiazolidine ring

blocks.prompt:
40 Beta-lactamases are:
(Beta-lactamases kya hain?)

options.text: insani enzymes jo penicillin banate hain
bacteria ke enzymes jo beta-lactam ring tor kar penicillin ko be-asar karte hain

blocks.explanation: Beta-lactamases bacteria ke enzymes hain jo beta-lactam ring par hamla kar ke penicillin ko be-asar kar dete hain (32.3.1).

book_ref.quote: as it is the site where bacterial enzymes called beta-lactamases can attack

blocks.prompt:
41 The part of penicillin crucial for its antibiotic activity is the:
(Penicillin ka kaun sa hissa us ki antibiotic activity ke liye sab se aham hai?)
blocks.explanation: Beta-lactam ring antibiotic activity ke liye sab se aham hai (32.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The beta-lactam ring is crucial for the antibiotic

blocks.prompt:
42 Penicillin is taken up by the bacterial cell-wall enzyme because penicillin resembles the enzyme's:
(Bacteria ka cell-wall enzyme penicillin ko kyun le leta hai? Penicillin kis se milti julti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin enzyme ke asal substrate (D-Ala-D-Ala sira) jaisi hai, is liye enzyme use substrate samajh leta hai (book correction, 32.3.1).

book_ref.quote: the enzyme takes penicillin for its substrate

blocks.prompt:
43 After penicillin inactivates the cell-wall enzyme, bacteria:
(Jab penicillin cell-wall enzyme ko be-asar kar de to bacteria ka kya hota hai?)

options.text: barhna band kar ke spores bana lete hain
baghair cell wall ke barhte rehte hain aur aakhir phat jate hain
aur mazboot cell wall bana lete hain

blocks.explanation: Bacteria barhte rehte hain magar kaam karne wali cell wall ke baghair, aakhir phat kar mar jate hain (32.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Bacteria continue to grow, but without the functional cell wall

blocks.prompt:
44 Penicillin does not harm human cells because human cells:
(Penicillin insani cells ko nuqsan kyun nahi deti?)

options.text: un ki cell wall nahi hoti

blocks.explanation: Insani cells ki cell wall nahi hoti, is liye penicillin unhein nuqsan nahi deti (32.3.1).

book_ref.quote: penicillin does not harm our cells

blocks.prompt:
45 Penicillin was discovered accidentally in 1928 by:
(1928 mein penicillin itefaqan kis ne daryaft ki?)
blocks.explanation: 1928 mein Alexander Fleming ne dekha ke petri dish par ugi phaphoondi ne aas paas ke bacteria maar diye (32.3.1).

book_ref.quote: In 1928, Alexander Fleming accidentally discovered penicillin

blocks.prompt:
46 The mold that released the substance which inhibited bacterial growth was later identified as:
(Jis phaphoondi (mold) ne bacteria ki growth roki, us ki pehchaan baad mein kya hui?)
blocks.explanation: Woh mold baad mein Penicillium nikli (32.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The mold, later identified as Penicillium

blocks.prompt:
47 Opiates are a class of drugs that come from:
(Opiates kis cheez se aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Opiates afeem ke poday (opium poppy) se aate hain; dard ki taqatwar dawa magar nasha-awar (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Opiates are a class of drugs that come from the opium poppy plant.

blocks.prompt:
48 Which of the following is listed as a legal opiate drug?
(In mein se kaun si qanooni (legal) opiate dawa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Legal opiates: morphine, codeine, oxycodone, hydrocodone; heroin ghair-qanooni hai (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: The legal drugs include the morphine, codeine, oxycodone, hydrocodone etc.

blocks.prompt:
49 The painkillers produced by the human brain itself are called:
(Insani dimagh khud jo dard-kush (painkillers) banata hai, unhein kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dimagh apne painkillers endorphins banata hai jo CNS ke opioid receptors se judte hain (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: The human brain produces our own painkillers called endorphins.

blocks.prompt:
50 The number of types of opioid receptors described is:
(Opioid receptors ki kitni qismein batayi gayi hain?)
blocks.explanation: Opioid receptors teen qism ke hain: mu (μ), kappa (κ), delta (δ) (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: There are three types of opioid receptors.

blocks.prompt:
51 The primary target for most opioids such as morphine is the:
(Morphine jaise aksar opioids ka bunyaadi nishana kaun sa receptor hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dimagh aur spinal cord ke mu receptors morphine jaise opioids ka asal nishana hain (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: These are primary target for most of the opioids like morphine.

blocks.prompt:
52 Besides analgesia, activation of mu receptors can also cause:
(Dard kam karne ke ilawa mu receptors ke active hone se aur kya ho sakta hai?)

options.text: saans dheemi hona aur shadeed euphoria

blocks.explanation: Mu receptors se saans ka dheema hona (respiratory depression) aur shadeed khushi ka ehsaas (euphoria) ho sakta hai (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: activation of these receptors can also cause respiratory depression and intense euphoria

blocks.prompt:
53 The opioid receptors involved in spinal analgesia and sedation but less associated with euphoria are:
(Kaun se opioid receptors spinal analgesia aur sedation (ghanoodgi) mein shamil hain magar euphoria se kam juray hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kappa receptors spinal analgesia aur sedation mein kaam aate hain, euphoria kam dete hain (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Kappa (κ) receptors are involved in spinal analgesia and sedation

blocks.prompt:
54 Delta (δ) opioid receptors play a vital role in:
(Delta (δ) receptors kis cheez mein aham kirdar ada karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Delta receptors jazbati radd-e-amal aur mood control mein aham hain (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Delta (δ) receptors play a vital role in emotional response and mood regulation.

blocks.prompt:
55 Opioid receptors are:
(Opioid receptors kya hain?)

options.text: dimagh aur spinal cord ke khaas proteins

blocks.explanation: Opioid receptors dimagh aur spinal cord mein khaas proteins hain jin se opiates judte hain (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Opiates work by binding to special proteins in the brain and spinal cord called opioid receptors.

blocks.prompt:
56 In the model of opiate action, the opiate and the receptor act as:
(Opiate ke amal ke model mein opiate aur receptor kya kirdar ada karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Opiate chaabi (key) aur receptor taala (lock) ki tarah kaam karte hain (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: It works like a key (opiate) and lock (receptor) model.

blocks.prompt:
57 When an opiate binds to its receptor, it:
(Jab opiate receptor se judta hai to kya karta hai?)

options.text: calcium channels band aur potassium channel khol deta hai
calcium khol aur potassium band karta hai

blocks.explanation: Judne par calcium channels band aur potassium channel khul jata hai, neuron hyperpolarize ho jata hai (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: it closes the calcium channels and opens the potassium channel

blocks.prompt:
58 Hyperpolarization of the neuron by an opiate:
(Opiate ki wajah se neuron ka hyperpolarize hona kya karta hai?)

options.text: dard ka signal tez kar deta hai
cell ke liye dard ka signal bhejna mushkil kar deta hai

blocks.explanation: Hyperpolarization se cell ke liye dard ka signal bhejna bohat mushkil ho jata hai (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: This hyperpolarizes the neuron, making it much harder for the cell to send the pain signal.

blocks.prompt:
59 Opiates give a sense of relief and well-being because, in the reward center of the brain, they cause excessive release of:
(Opiates dimagh ke reward center mein kis cheez ka ziyada ikhraaj karwate hain jis se sukoon milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Opiates reward center mein dopamine ka ziyada ikhraaj karwate hain jo sukoon ka ehsaas deta hai (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: leading to excessive release of dopamine

blocks.prompt:
60 Codeine is used in cough syrups because it:
(Codeine khansi ke sharbat mein kyun dali jati hai?)

options.text: khansi ka reflex daba deti hai

blocks.explanation: Codeine khansi ka reflex (khud-ba-khud khansi) daba deti hai (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Opioids like codeine is used in cough syrups as they suppress the cough reflex.

blocks.prompt:
61 By binding to receptors in the gastrointestinal tract, opioids can:
(Gastrointestinal tract (nizam-e-hazma) ke receptors se jud kar opioids kya kar sakte hain?)

options.text: hazma dheema kar ke dast mein aaraam

blocks.explanation: Opioids hazme ko dheema kar ke dast (diarrhea) mein aaraam de sakte hain (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: slows down digestion and can alleviate diarrhea

blocks.prompt:
62 Heroin, before it became a street drug, was:
(Street drug banne se pehle heroin kya thi?)

options.text: Bayer ki trademark dawa, morphine ka 'non-addictive' mutabadil

blocks.explanation: Heroin (diacetylmorphine) Bayer bechta tha, morphine ka 'non-addictive' mutabadil aur khansi ki dawa bana kar (32.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Heroin (diacetylmorphine) was a trademarked medicine sold by Bayer

blocks.prompt:
63 Which statement about bacteria and viruses is correct?
(Bacteria aur viruses ke baare mein kaun sa bayan sahi hai?)

options.text: dono sirf hamare cells mein rehne wale parasites
